notes: FRESH (2026-10-14). Apple Inc Form 10-K, fiscal year ended 2025-09-27. 公司与原件在本次任务前未出现在任何 benchmark gold、findings、规则或调参记录中；support set 在读取任何新输出前冻结。原HTML无物理页，全部以 location_kind=document 用真实 DOM locator 匹配；不声称存在PDF页码。

any_support_sets.exact_quote: reportable segments consist of the Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan and Rest of Asia Pacific

facts.reason: Apple 按**地域**报告分部，共5个：Americas/Europe/Greater China/Japan/Rest of Asia Pacific。产品线（iPhone/Mac等）不是报告分部。

any_support_sets.exact_quote: fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September
For the fiscal year ended September 27 , 2025

facts.reason: Apple财年止于**9月最后一个周六**（FY2025止于2025-09-27），不是日历年。把FY2025当2025日历年是期间错位。

any_support_sets.exact_quote: Greater China net sales decreased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to lower net sales of iPhone, partially offset by higher net sales of Mac

must_not_assert: Greater China net sales increased in 2025
facts.reason: 大中华区净销售**下降**，因iPhone走弱、部分被Mac抵消。方向是降，主因是iPhone，不得翻成增长或主因换成服务。

any_support_sets.exact_quote: Beginning in the second quarter of 2025, new U.S. Tariffs were announced, including additional tariffs on imports from China, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Vietnam and the EU

must_not_assert: 关税自2025年初起全面生效
关税对中国以外地区无影响
facts.reason: 新美国关税自**2025年第二季度**宣布，覆盖中国/印度/日本/韩国/台湾/越南/欧盟等。风险限定：起点是Q2 2025，范围是多国，不得简化为全年或单一国家。

any_support_sets.exact_quote: fiscal years 2025 and 2024 spanned 52 weeks each, whereas fiscal year 2023 spanned 53 weeks

facts.reason: FY2025/FY2024各52周，FY2023为53周。周数差异影响同比可比性，不得把53周错配给2025。

any_support_sets.exact_quote: A significant majority of the Company’s manufacturing is performed in whole or in part by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan and Vietnam

must_not_assert: Apple制造全部位于美国本土
facts.reason: 制造主要由外包伙伴承担，集中在大陆/印度/日韩/台湾/越南。供应链地域限定属风险事实，不得说成全美国本土制造。
